easyPrerequisites: There is an applicable target for Depths of Desire.
description:
Cast Depths of Desire by paying its mana cost.
Holding priority, cast Lutri without paying its mana cost due to Aluren.
When Lutri enters, it triggers, copying Depths of Desire.
Resolve the Depths of Desire copy, returning Lutri from the battlefield to your hand.
Repeat from step 2.
